headline: Chicago Rapper DoodieLo really couldn’t let that one slide. The rapper took a shot at Raud
body: Chicago Rapper DoodieLo really couldn’t let that one slide. The rapper took a shot at Raud over his “I think I’m Clova now” lyrics, throwing the line “you don’t think no more huh” into the mix following the situation involving Reggie. The timing is what makes this even crazier, because Doodie Lo is bringing the lyrics back into the conversation at a time when the situation has already been getting people talking. kaicenat.
